_meta.title: Layer Split (see-through)
_meta.description: One illustration -> ~24 tagged, amodally completed RGBA parts (back hair, topwear, face, irides, ...) with a per-part depth map, via the ComfyUI-See-through custom node pack (github.com/shitagaki-lab/see-through @ 98d754bf, MIT): SDXL LayerDiff3D (layerdifforg/seethroughv0.0.2_layerdiff3d) generates the layers, Marigold (layerdifforg/seethroughv0.0.1_marigold) their depth; weights RAIL++-M under models/SeeThrough/, auto_download off. SavePSD writes <prefix>_<ts>_<uid>_<tag>.png + _depth.png per part and a _layers.json manifest into the output root and returns the manifest path, which PreviewAny surfaces as the job's text output. CJLayerPreview (Adrift cj_image_tools) renders the job image: the parts recomposited per pixel by depth beside a labelled parts sheet (the pack's own preview drops alpha, so every part shows as a box). Builder: src/lib/oj/seeThrough.ts.
